On £45,000 in 2026/27 (England, Wales or NI, code 1257L) take-home pay is £33,096.75 a year, £2,758.06 a month or £636.48 a week. Income tax £6,036, National Insurance £2,414.40, student loan £1,202.85, pension £2,250 (salary sacrifice).

Estimate for one employment, worked out on annual figures. Payroll works per pay period, so a payslip can differ by a few pounds. Not tax advice.
